_about: Form field -> where its value comes from. "document.X" = X read from the joint holder's KYC documents (see ../document-data-dictionary.json); "|surname" etc. = the part of it this box wants; "typed" = from the batch Excel or the review screen; "default.X" = usually X, the Excel can change it; "copy.X" = same as field X unless typed separately; "today" = today's date; "tick" = a tick box, answered per client in the Excel (never assumed).
